name: Amit International Limited
about: Amit International Limited engages in spinning, texturizing, crimping, and twisting staple, synthetic fiber, silk, cotton, wool, flax, hemp, jute, and other fiber products, as well as yarn or raw materials in India. The company trades textiles, fabrics, readymade garments, yarns, hosieries, cotton and blended socks, vests, underwear, diamonds, brass wiping cables, and other knitted fabrics, as well as textiles made of art-silk, rayon, staple products. It offers socks, boxers, gloves, T-shirts, and thermal wear. In addition, the company exports its products. Amit International Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.
